body_text:
Fix ordered bases of finite-dimensional vector spaces. Sending a
linear map to its matrix is a vector-space isomorphism, and
composition of maps corresponds to matrix multiplication. The
apparently asymmetric row-by-column rule is forced by this
requirement.
